scope.purpose: Record executable-side entry economics, daily read-only liquidation marks, and immutable hold-to-expiry outcomes for every published option candidate.
not_in_scope: broker accounts, positions, orders, fills, cancellations, or watchlists
automatic trade exits or order placement
new strategy, symbol, entry filter, sizing rule, or promotion rule

canonical_measurement.entry_credit: For a short vertical: (short bid - long ask) * 100.
canonical_measurement.daily_exit_debit: For a short vertical: (short ask - long bid) * 100.
canonical_measurement.daily_mark_pnl: entry cash + natural closing cash - fixed round-trip costs.
canonical_measurement.expiry_spread_value: (max(short strike - terminal spot, 0) - max(long strike - terminal spot, 0)) * 100.
canonical_measurement.expiry_pnl: entry credit - expiry spread value - fixed round-trip costs.
canonical_measurement.hit: settled P&L > 0 after fixed round-trip costs
canonical_measurement.terminal_spot: last completed local Qlib close on or before expiration

marking_rules.frequency: Once per weekday during the 09:35 America/New_York Codex workflow when open positions have stored Robinhood instrument IDs.
marking_rules.quote_source: Robinhood get_option_quotes only; no account or order tools.
marking_rules.missing_stale_or_malformed_quote: Reject that position mark; preserve the open position and prior marks.
marking_rules.effect: Informational only; a mark never closes a position or changes candidate selection.

trial_accounting.reason: This freezes observation and accounting mechanics without selecting an exit rule. Any take-profit, stop-loss, DTE exit, or parameter variant must be separately pre-registered and counted.
